description: This file defines a migration class for version 4.9.0 of the OrangeHRM system. It handles database schema updates such as creating tables, adding columns, inserting data, and configuring menu items and themes during an upgrade process.

classes.name: Migration
classes.description: A database migration class for updating the OrangeHRM system to version 4.9.0, handling schema changes, data insertions, and menu configurations.

methods.name: up
methods.description: Executes the migration steps, such as creating tables, adding columns, inserting themes, and configuring menu items for system upgrade.

methods.name: getVersion
methods.description: Returns the migration version as a string '4.9'.

methods.name: insertMenuItems
methods.description: Inserts a menu item into the system's menu hierarchy with specified parameters.

methods.name: insertTheme
methods.description: Inserts a new theme into the database with specified name and variables.
